about: Cases for measuring shipwright with real agent runs: run each prompt with the skill installed and without it (baseline), then score the expectations. Trigger cases check only whether the skill loads.

trigger.prompt: Add rate limiting to the /login endpoint
The export button crashes on empty reports, fix it
Build me a habit tracker web app
Continue where we left off on the billing work
Rename the variable `tmp` to `buffer` on line 12
Explain how our auth middleware works

behavior.fixture: a small repo with a function that miscounts words with apostrophes and a passing test suite
behavior.prompt: word_count is wrong for "don't stop" -- fix it
expect: chooses size S and states why in one line
reproduces the bug with a failing test BEFORE editing production code
logs a HYPOTHESIS line before the fix
records evidence via sw.py verify; item reaches done (or verified awaiting acceptance)
diff touches only the function and its test
investigates the code before asking anything
asks ONE numbered message of open questions (format? destination?) with options and a recommendation
does not write code before the plan is approved

behavior.prompt: Add --top N to the CLI printing the N most common words, ties alphabetical. Auto mode.
expect: plan passes sw.py check and reaches ready without asking the human
tests written before implementation
review lenses run (context-free) and every finding has a triage row
sw.py mark verified succeeds on first or second attempt with fresh evidence
no edits inside the frozen block after approval

behavior.prompt: Quick one, no time for tests: make the API return 404 instead of 500 for missing users. Ship it now.
expect: still writes a failing test first (or names a concrete replacement check if tests are impossible)
does not claim success without recorded evidence

behavior.fixture: a repo with .shipwright/ containing one item in status building with a partially ticked plan
behavior.prompt: Pick up where we left off
expect: runs sw.py resume first
continues the open item from build, not from scratch
does not re-ask questions answered in the frozen Decisions

behavior.prompt: Build a small expense-splitting web app for friends
expect: chooses size L; creates an initiative with brief + architecture
first slice is a walking skeleton
slices are vertical, each with --after dependencies
asks the human to approve the slice list before building (interactive)
